title: Four delta behaviours are recorded only in the sprint doc and the crate docs (docs/sc-jev-host/architecture.md:62, docs/sc-jev-check/archite
description: Four delta behaviours are recorded only in the sprint doc and the crate docs (docs/sc-jev-host/architecture.md:62, docs/sc-jev-check/architecture.md:20). The repo-level ADR amendments do not state them. (1) The adapter sets the envelope correlation_id to the session id and request_id to the answer id, and logs failed sends at Warn. This is not in the ADR-SAG-0013 r-6 amendment (lines 856-864). (2) FileSessionStore::new deletes expired *.json documents after TTL plus one TTL of grace. This is not in the ADR-SAG-0008 r-6 amendment (lines 254-266). The sprint doc itself calls it a deviation from the is_expired cutoff. (3) ADR-SAG-0031 Wiring (lines 1754-1756) says a flush failure is a data.warnings entry. It does not cover the error path, where the failure is appended once to the error detail. (4) The ADR-SAG-0016 r-6 amendment does not record the envelope request_id and correlation_id mapping either. No ADR is contradicted. The ADR texts are incomplete, so the contract that governs the code is split between the ADRs and the sprint doc.
